description: Source code for VP9 VAAPI video decoder delegate in Chromium, handling VP9 decoding via VAAPI on Linux/ChromeOS, including buffer management, decryption setup, and surface handling.

classes.name: VP9VaapiVideoDecoderDelegate
classes.description: A class that manages VP9 video decoding using VAAPI, including buffer creation, decryption, and surface output.

methods.name: CreateVP9Picture
methods.description: Creates a new VP9 picture object associated with a VAAPI surface.

methods.name: SubmitDecode
methods.description: Prepares and submits VP9 frame data for decoding via VAAPI, handling buffers, decryption, and execution.

methods.name: OutputPicture
methods.description: Outputs a decoded VP9 picture, signaling that the surface is ready.

methods.name: NeedsCompressedHeaderParsed
methods.description: Indicates whether compressed headers need parsing; returns false.

methods.name: GetFrameContext
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the frame context; not implemented, returns false.

methods.name: OnVAContextDestructionSoon
methods.description: Cleans up buffers before VA context destruction.
